mapper.select: /* getSensorSelectStatics */ SELECT A.SENSOR_TYPE AS sensorName ,ROUND(RATIO_TO_REPORT(SUM(B.READING_VALUE)) OVER(PARTITION BY GROUPING_ID(A.SENSOR_TYPE)) * 100,2) AS sensorValue FROM SENSOR A, SENSOR_DATA B WHERE A.SENSOR_ID = B.SENSOR_ID AND A.INSTALL_DATE BETWEEN #{srtDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY A.SENSOR_TYPE

/* getCntryEneAmnt */ SELECT B.LOCATION_DATA AS locationData ,ROUND(RATIO_TO_REPORT(SUM(ENERGY_AMOUNT)) OVER(PARTITION BY GROUPING_ID(B.LOCATION_DATA)) * 100,2) as energyAmount FROM ENERGY_USAGE A, FACILITY_LOCATION B WHERE 1=1 AND A.FACILITY_ID = B.LOCATION_ID AND A.USAGE_DATE BETWEEN #{srtDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY B.LOCATION_DATA
